remarks: Welcome to 15272 Valeda Drive, a beautifully reimagined La Mirada residence where timeless architectural character meets stunning modern design! Offering 4 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 beautifully remodeled bathrooms, and 1,914 square feet of inviting living space, this exceptional home has been thoughtfully transformed with the stylish finishes today's buyers love. The true showstopper is the spectacular family room, featuring soaring vaulted ceilings with gorgeous natural wood planking and dramatic exposed beams, an extraordinary wall of floor-to-ceiling windows that floods the space with natural light, and a beautifully updated fireplace that creates a warm and inviting focal point.
